# Data Model: Notification Record

**Used in:** `src/lib/stores/notifications.ts`, `src/lib/components/Toast.svelte`, `src/lib/components/Toaster.svelte`

## TypeScript Interface

```ts
export type NotificationType = 'overdue' | 'mention' | 'activity';

export interface Notification {
  /** UUID generated by crypto.randomUUID() at push time. */
  id: string;

  /** Discriminator for visual accent and semantics. */
  type: NotificationType;

  /** Short heading shown prominently in the toast. Max ~40 chars in practice. */
  title: string;

  /** Descriptive body text. Max ~120 chars in practice. */
  message: string;

  /** ISO 8601 timestamp (new Date().toISOString()) at push time. Used for eviction ordering. */
  createdAt: string;
}
```

## Store Shape

```ts
// notifications store value type
type NotificationQueue = Notification[];  // length: 0–5, ordered by createdAt ascending
```

The store array is ordered ascending by `createdAt` (oldest first at index 0). The `Toaster.svelte` component reverses this for display so the newest toast appears visually on top.

## Capacity Rule

When `push` is called and `queue.length >= 5`, the record with the **lowest `createdAt`** (index 0 after sorting) is removed before appending. In practice the array is already sorted, so this is always `queue[0]`.

## Type-to-Accent Mapping

| `type` | Tailwind color class | Semantic meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `overdue` | `bg-red-500` / `border-red-500` | Time-critical alert |
| `mention` | `bg-blue-500` / `border-blue-500` | Direct address |
| `activity` | `bg-yellow-400` / `border-yellow-400` | Ambient board change |

## BroadcastChannel Wire Format

`Notification` records are serialized as-is via `channel.postMessage()`. All fields are JSON-safe primitives, so no special serialization is needed. The `id` is stable across tabs — tab B receives and stores the exact same `id` as tab A, enabling cross-tab `dismiss` to work correctly.

## Known Message Strings

| Trigger | `title` | `message` format |
|---|---|---|
| Overdue card | `"Card Overdue"` | `todo.text` |
| Mention | `"You were mentioned"` | `"Mentioned in <card text> by <commenter name>"` |
| Card moved | `"Board Updated"` | `"'<card title>' moved to <column title>"` |
| Column added | `"Board Updated"` | `"New column '<title>' added"` |
| Column renamed | `"Board Updated"` | `"Column renamed to '<title>'"` |
